quotes.text: should select the signing subkey, even though no secret key is available

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The new task imports an Ofelia public-key fixture, finds its primary handle and checks that findSuitableSigningKeyID returns the expected signing-subkey ID. Both assertions have expected-behavior messages. The task does not call GPGME or create/verify a signature; primary fallback, no candidate and invalid-subkey cases are outside its direct assertions. Native integration belongs to a separate follow-up test, and no test ran here.
title: The public signing-key selection test checks an ID without invoking GPGME
